entities.name: Chronic pancreatitis
observations: Chronic fibroinflammatory pancreatic disease associated with abdominal pain and structural imaging changes.

entities.name: PMID:33158979
observations: Nationwide longitudinal cohort of 1,131 patients; continuous and intermittent pain groups had no differences in imaging morphology; 61% of followed patients alternated pain patterns over median 47 months.

entities.name: PMID:31630919
observations: CT morphology cohort of 158 patients; functional abnormalities generally correlated with imaging, but presence of pain did not.

entities.name: Pain pattern not imaging-linked
observations: In a prospective longitudinal cohort of 1,131 patients, continuous versus intermittent pain was not associated with morphological imaging findings; pain patterns frequently changed over time.

entities.name: CT pain association absent
observations: In a retrospective CT cohort of 158 patients, imaging morphology correlated with functional abnormalities but generally not with presence of pain.

entities.name: PMID:35396813
observations: Cross-sectional cohort of 742 patients found severe pancreatic calcifications were negatively associated with abdominal pain, among other imaging-complication associations.
